title: Each waiting-page pin compares head and main live in the same browser, with no browser number hard-coded
why: Pins measured in one Chromium build go red in another, so CI fails on a page that did not change.
note: Red half split from #2347 (coordinator  CST Nov 10; rule roles-review-cap-three; round 1, try 1). What failed: run 42826717966 at 6602adf8a. 10 waiting-page pin cases red (for example "Ask box presses at x [1010,1122,1134,1267] at 1440, not the pinned [1012,1123,1135,1267]"), and 2 of the 12 F1 cases ("title box is 333.0 px at 520 wide, not main's 331.5 px"). Cause (test-author): pins measured in the sandbox's Playwright 1.63 Chromium; CI runs 1.64.1. Fix: a CI step passes main's page to the suite (for example `git show origin/main:skills/waiting-page/page.html` into an env path), so each pin compares head and main live in the same browser. Coordinator asked for ready; filed blocked, because it waits for #2347 to merge. #2347 drops those cases with a Drops-lines trailer naming this slug. Related: page-pins-font-dependent (the guard against the next font-bound pin).
